audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for sheepfold, door, good shepherd, one flock, Dedication feast, Father/Son oneness, hand imagery, Psalm gods quotation, Jordan return.

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: the one not entering through the door into the sheepfold, but climbing up another way, that one is a thief and robber.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

verses.restored: But the one entering through the door is shepherd of the sheep.

familiar.text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.restored: To this one the gatekeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

familiar.text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

verses.restored: When he has brought out all his own, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.

familiar.text: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

verses.restored: A stranger they will certainly not follow, but they will flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers.

familiar.text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

verses.restored: Jesus spoke this figure of speech to them, but they did not know what the things were that he was speaking to them.

familiar.text: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore said again, Amen, amen, I say to you: I am the door of the sheep.

familiar.text: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

verses.restored: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.

familiar.text: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

verses.restored: I am the door. If anyone enters through me, that one will be saved/healed and will go in and go out and find pasture.

familiar.text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

verses.restored: The thief does not come except to steal, kill, and destroy. I came so that they may have life and have abundance.

familiar.text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

verses.restored: I am the beautiful/good shepherd. The beautiful/good shepherd lays down his life/soul for the sheep.

familiar.text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

verses.restored: The hired worker, not being shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees; the wolf seizes them and scatters them.

familiar.text: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

verses.restored: He flees because he is a hired worker and it does not matter to him about the sheep.

familiar.text: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

verses.restored: I am the beautiful/good shepherd, and I know my own, and my own know me,

familiar.text: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

verses.restored: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father; and I lay down my life/soul for the sheep.

familiar.text: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

verses.restored: I have other sheep that are not from this fold; it is necessary for me to lead those also, and they will hear my voice, and there will be one flock, one shepherd.

familiar.text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

verses.restored: Because of this the Father loves me, because I lay down my life/soul so that I may take it again.

familiar.text: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

verses.restored: No one takes it from me; rather I lay it down from myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it again. This command I received from my Father.

familiar.text: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

verses.restored: Again division happened among the Judeans because of these words.

familiar.text: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

verses.restored: Many of them were saying, He has a troubling spirit and is mad; why hear him?

familiar.text: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

verses.restored: Others said, These are not the words of one troubled by a spirit. Is a troubling spirit able to open the eyes of the blind?

familiar.text: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

verses.restored: Then the Dedication happened in Jerusalem; it was winter.

familiar.text: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

verses.restored: Jesus was walking in the temple, in the portico of Solomon.

familiar.text: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.

verses.restored: The Judeans therefore surrounded him and were saying to him, How long do you keep our soul/life suspended? If you are the Messiah, tell us openly.

familiar.text: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

verses.restored: Jesus answered them, I told you, and you do not trust. The works that I do in my Father's name, these bear witness concerning me.

familiar.text: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

verses.restored: But you do not trust, because you are not from my sheep.

familiar.text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

verses.restored: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

familiar.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

verses.restored: I give them age-long life, and they will certainly not perish into the age, and no one will seize them out of my hand.

familiar.text: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

verses.restored: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all, and no one is able to seize out of the Father's hand.

familiar.text: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

verses.restored: I and the Father are one.

familiar.text: I and my Father are one.

verses.restored: The Judeans again picked up stones so that they might stone him.

familiar.text: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

verses.restored: Jesus answered them, Many beautiful/good works I showed you from the Father; because of which work among them do you stone me?

familiar.text: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

verses.restored: The Judeans answered him, We do not stone you concerning a beautiful/good work, but concerning blasphemy, and because you, being human, make yourself Divine.

familiar.text: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

verses.restored: Jesus answered them, Has it not been written in your Law, I said, you are gods/divine ones?

familiar.text: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

verses.restored: If he called those gods/divine ones to whom the word of the Divine came, and the Scripture cannot be broken,

familiar.text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

verses.restored: do you say of the one whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, You blaspheme, because I said, I am Son of the Divine?

familiar.text: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

verses.restored: If I do not do the works of my Father, do not trust me.

familiar.text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

verses.restored: But if I do them, even if you do not trust me, trust the works, so that you may know and keep knowing that the Father is in me and I in the Father.

familiar.text: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

verses.restored: Therefore they were seeking again to seize him, and he went out from their hand.

familiar.text: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

verses.restored: He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was baptizing at first, and he remained there.

familiar.text: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

verses.restored: Many came to him and were saying, John indeed did no sign, but everything John said about this one was true.

familiar.text: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

verses.restored: And many there trusted into him.

familiar.text: And many believed on him there.
